noTeam.q: Can I come without a team?
noTeam.a: Yes. If you don't have a team, just register solo. After the run we'll help form teams among participants based on their results.

cost.q: How much does it cost to take part?
cost.a: As ACE BATTLE is entering the Polish market for the first time, the first Warsaw qualifier is open to all participants free of charge.

deadline.a: Online registration is open until all spots are filled. On-site registration is available from 09:00 — but only while spots remain, with 300 available in total. We recommend registering in advance!

kids.a: Yes, kids are welcome as spectators alongside adults. Participation in the run depends on the format's age rules.

prep.a: No. The format is designed for any level — from beginners to seasoned runners. What matters is team spirit and the will to play.

bring.a: Comfortable sportswear and shoes, a good mood, and a bit of water. You'll get your bib and timing chip on site.

spectator.q: Can I come as a spectator?
spectator.a: Of course! We have stands for fans, an on-site café, and a full show throughout the day.

documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.intro: This Privacy Policy outlines the rules for the collection, processing, use, and protection of personal data of users of this website. The website administration respects every user's right to privacy and is committed to protecting the information provided in accordance with applicable laws. By using this website, the user confirms their agreement with this Privacy Policy and the terms of personal data processing described herein.

p: The data controller within the meaning of GDPR is:
list: Company name: ACE BATTLE POLAND Sp. z o.o.
Address: ul. Pańska 96/80, 00-837 Warszawa
National Court Register number (KRS): 0001229475
Email for data protection enquiries: info@poland.acebattle.run

p: While using the website, personal and technical information may be collected. Data may be provided voluntarily by the user or collected automatically during website visits.
Such information may include:
list: Name
Email address
Phone number
Information submitted through forms on the website
Transaction data relating to ACER credit in the Wallet (amount, currency, date, payment identifier — never card details)
outro: This information is used solely to the extent necessary for the proper operation of the website.

p: The collected information is used to ensure the proper functioning of the website, provide services, maintain communication with users, and process inquiries or requests.
Personal data may also be processed for the purpose of improving content quality, optimizing website structure, and analyzing the effectiveness of website performance.

The website administration does not process personal data for hidden or unlawful purposes and does not use such data in any manner that may violate the rights, freedoms, or legitimate interests of users.
Where a user buys ACER credit in the Wallet, personal data is additionally processed for the following purposes and on the following legal bases:
list: processing the payment and delivering the purchased credit — performance of a contract with the user (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR);
keeping records of financial transactions, accounting books and tax documentation — compliance with a legal obligation of the controller (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR);
preventing fraud, chargeback abuse and abuse of the reward programme, and securing the transaction ledger — the legitimate interests of the controller (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

p: The website administration takes appropriate measures to ensure the security of personal data and prevent unauthorized access to it.
Information is stored only for as long as necessary to achieve the purposes for which it was collected or as required by applicable law.
Technical and organizational security measures are implemented to minimize the risks of loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure, or misuse of personal data.

By way of exception to the above, records of financial transactions — purchases of ACER credit, the entries in the Wallet ledger and the related accounting documents — are kept for approximately 5 years counted from the end of the accounting year in which the transaction took place, as required by the Polish Accounting Act and tax legislation. That obligation takes precedence over a request to delete data: such records are retained for the statutory period even after the user's account has been deleted, and are removed afterwards.
The website may use cookies and third-party analytics services to collect statistical information and improve website performance.
Cookies help store user preferences and analyze interactions with the website.
Users may:
list: Accept the use of cookies;
Restrict or disable cookies through their browser settings.
outro: Please note that disabling cookies may affect the proper functioning of certain website features.

sections.h: Data recipients and transfers outside the EEA
p: Personal data is disclosed only to entities that process it on the controller's behalf, or that must receive it in order for a requested service to be provided, and only to the extent necessary.

Card payments and purchases of ACER credit in the Wallet are handled by Stripe, Inc. and Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd., acting as an independent controller of the payment data. Stripe receives the buyer's name and email address and the metadata of the transaction (amount, currency, the credit purchased and the internal account identifier).
list: Card and other payment-instrument details are entered on Stripe's own payment page and transmitted directly to Stripe — the platform never receives or stores them.

Stripe may transfer data to the United States. Such transfers are covered by the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and, to the extent it does not apply, by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
Stripe also processes payment data for its own purposes, in particular fraud prevention and its own legal obligations, on the basis of its own privacy policy.
outro: Data may also be disclosed to the hosting, email-delivery and analytics providers used to operate the website, and to public authorities where the law requires it.

p: Users have the right to obtain information about the processing of their personal data, request correction or deletion of their data, and withdraw their consent to data processing where applicable.

The website administration reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes become effective immediately upon publication on the website. Users are encouraged to review this section periodically to stay informed about updates.

documents.title: Terms of Use
documents.intro: These Terms of Use govern access to and use of this website. By accessing or using the website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these Terms, you should discontinue use of the website immediately.

p: Users agree to use the website only for lawful purposes and in a manner that does not infringe upon the rights, freedoms, or legitimate interests of others.
Users are prohibited from:
list: Publishing false, harmful, or unlawful content;
Interfering with the operation or security of the website;

Engaging in any activity that may damage the website, its administration, or other users.

p: The website administration strives to ensure that all information published on the website is accurate, current, and reliable. However, no guarantees are made regarding the completeness, accuracy, or availability of the content.
All information provided on the website is for informational purposes only and should not be considered legal, financial, medical, or professional advice unless expressly stated otherwise.

No content from this website may be copied, reproduced, distributed, modified, or otherwise used without prior written permission from the website owner, except where permitted by applicable law.
The website may contain links to third-party websites or services. The website administration is not responsible for the content, privacy practices, terms, or actions of any third-party websites.
Users access third-party websites at their own risk.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the website administration shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the website.
The website administration is also not responsible for temporary unavailability, technical errors, interruptions, or actions of third parties that may affect website performance.

The platform provides a signed-in user with a personal Wallet in which they may hold ACER — prepaid credit issued by ACE BATTLE POLAND Sp. z o.o. and usable only inside this platform. For accounting purposes a fixed denomination applies: 1 ACER = 1 USD.
ACER credit:
list: may be used only within this platform, and only for the goods and services the platform makes available for it;
is not transferable — it cannot be moved to another user, sold, assigned or given away;
cannot be withdrawn, exchanged for money or paid out in cash; the platform provides no payout mechanism of any kind;
bears no interest and does not grow in value over time;
is not a payment instrument, electronic money, a security, an investment product, or a means of payment accepted outside this platform.
outro: Because ACER can be used only for the issuer's own goods and services within a limited network, it is not electronic money and its issuance is not a payment service.

ACER exists solely as an entry in the platform's internal transaction ledger. A balance is the sum of the entries recorded against the user's account. The ledger is append-only: a correction is always made by adding an offsetting entry, never by changing or deleting history.

p: The platform may credit ACER to a user as a reward — for example for being checked in at an event, or for introducing another person who is later checked in at an event. Reward amounts and the list of rewarded actions are set by the platform and published in the Wallet.
The reward programme operates on the following terms:
list: reward amounts and the list of rewarded actions may be changed, suspended or ended at any time, with effect for the future;
rewards are credited only for actions that actually took place; a reward granted in error, twice, or as a result of a technical fault may be reversed by an offsetting entry;

rewards are personal: creating additional or fictitious accounts, referring oneself, automated sign-ups and any other attempt to obtain rewards without genuine participation are prohibited and may lead to reversal of the affected credit and to suspension of the account;
rewards are granted from the date the programme starts and are not applied retroactively to earlier events or earlier introductions;
a reward is not a discount, a price reduction or a monetary claim, and no user has a right to be granted one.

sections.h: Buying ACER, right of withdrawal and refunds
p: A signed-in user may buy ACER by payment card. Payments are processed in US dollars (USD) by Stripe; the price is exactly 1 USD per 1 ACER, purchases are made in whole ACER, and the amounts available in a single transaction (the fixed packs and the permitted range for a custom amount) are shown on the purchase screen. The platform adds no fee of its own; a currency-conversion charge may be applied by the user's own bank.

Purchased ACER is credited to the Wallet as soon as the payment is confirmed by Stripe. This may take a short moment after payment — until then the Wallet shows the transaction together with its status.

Because the credit is digital content supplied immediately, at checkout the consumer expressly requests that the credit be delivered before the end of the 14-day withdrawal period, and acknowledges that once it has been delivered they lose the right of withdrawal provided for in the Polish Act on Consumer Rights of 30 May 2014 (implementing Directive 2011/83/EU). Confirming the purchase constitutes that request and that acknowledgment.

Irrespective of the above, the platform undertakes — as a voluntary commitment — to refund the amount paid for purchased ACER that has not been spent, if the user asks within 14 days of the purchase. Requests are made to the contact address given in these Terms; the refund is returned to the original payment method in the amount actually paid, and the corresponding credit is removed from the Wallet by an offsetting ledger entry. ACER received as a reward has no monetary value and is never refunded in money.

sections.h: Your balance if the account is deleted
p: A user may ask for their account to be deleted at any time. Deleting the account ends access to the Wallet, and any remaining ACER balance — purchased or awarded as a reward — expires without compensation, save for the refund described above of unspent ACER purchased within the last 14 days, provided the user asks for it before the account is deleted.

The platform does not delete records of financial transactions whose retention is required by law (see the Privacy Policy). Those records are kept for the statutory period even after the account itself has been removed.

sections.h: What ACER can be used for
p: ACER is intended for use within the platform for paid event entries, season licences and comparable paid features, and as a prize within the series. Participation in current events is free, so at present there may be nothing that ACER can be spent on. The platform makes no promise as to when any particular redemption option will become available, and a user should buy ACER only if they accept that.

The platform decides what ACER can be used for and at what price, and may add, change or withdraw individual redemption options. Withdrawing an option does not take away ACER already held — it remains usable for the remaining options.
The website administration reserves the right to modify, update, or replace these Terms of Use at any time without prior notice.
Any changes become effective immediately upon publication on the website. Users are encouraged to review these Terms periodically to stay informed of any updates.
Continued use of the website following the publication of any changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms of Use.
Any questions regarding these Terms may be directed to the website administration using the contact information provided on the website.

profile.empty: You are not on a team yet. Create one, or ask a captain for their team code.

requests.listEmpty: No team is looking for runners right now. Create one, or come back later.
requests.listEmptyCategory: No team in this category is looking for runners right now.
requests.sentBody: Your request is with the captain. You will get an email as soon as they answer.

requests.confirmHint: You can withdraw your request at any time from your profile.
requests.signInHint: You need an account to ask to join. We will bring you straight back here.
requests.invitedNotice: {team} has already invited you. Pressing the button puts you on the roster right away.

requests.profileGateBody: A roster is built from runners, so we need your name, date of birth, sex and phone before you can ask to join.

requests.memberTitle: You are already on this team
requests.memberBody: You are on the roster of {team}, so there is nothing to ask for.
requests.pendingBody: You have already asked to join {team}. The captain has not answered yet.
requests.queueEmpty: Nobody has asked to join. Share the team code or the join link to be found.

reasons.profile: Complete your profile first — we need your name, date of birth, sex and phone.
reasons.age: You must be 18 or older to be on a team.
reasons.forbidden: Only the team's captain can do that.
reasons.name_taken: That team name is already taken.
reasons.roster_full: This team is already at its maximum.
reasons.sex_balance: A mixed team must keep room for at least four men and four women.
reasons.wrong_category: This team's category does not admit you.
reasons.already_member: You are already on this team.
reasons.already_in_category: You already hold a team in this category. Leave it first.
reasons.used: That link has already been used.
reasons.manager_must_hand_over: Make another member captain before you leave.
reasons.invalid: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
reasons.incomplete_team: The team is not complete yet.
reasons.not_open: Registration for this event is not open.
reasons.already_entered: This team is already entered in this event.
reasons.member_underage: A member will be under 18 on the event date.
reasons.registered_individually: A member is already registered individually for this night — one entry per runner per night.
reasons.already_checked_in: The team is already checked in — the entry is locked.
reasons.consent_pending: A member has not confirmed their participation yet.
reasons.invalid_composition: The race composition does not meet the rules.
reasons.bib_pool: Not enough bibs left in the pool.
reasons.not_reserve: That runner is not a reserve on this entry.
reasons.remind_limit: A reminder was already sent in the last 24 hours.
reasons.insufficient_balance: You do not have enough ACER to create a team.

roster.managerHint: Make another runner captain before you leave, or dissolve the team if it is not coming together.
roster.leaveMessage: Your seat on the roster is removed. You can be invited or ask to join again later.
roster.removeMessage: {name} loses their seat on the roster and is told by email. You can invite them again later.
roster.handOverMessage: {name} becomes the captain and you become an ordinary member. Only they can hand it back.
roster.dissolveMessage: The team, its roster, its invitations and its join requests are deleted for good, and every remaining member is told by email. This cannot be undone.

invitation.subject: {team} invited you to join
invitation.subjectOnBehalf: You have been invited to join {team}
invitation.title: Join {team}
invitation.bodyOnBehalf: The organiser invited you to join {team} on the team's behalf.
invitation.intro: Open the link below to see the team and accept or decline. If you do not have an account yet, we will sign you up first and bring you straight back.
invitation.ignore: If this is not for you, you can ignore this message.

invitationAccepted.subject: {name} joined {team}
invitationAccepted.title: {name} joined
invitationAccepted.roster: The roster now has {count} of the {min} runners it needs.
invitationAccepted.rosterComplete: The roster now has {count} runners — the team is complete.

requestReceived.subject: {name} asked to join {team}
requestReceived.title: {name} asked to join
requestReceived.roster: The roster has {count} of the {min} runners it needs.
requestReceived.rosterComplete: The roster has {count} runners — the team is already complete.
requestReceived.intro: Accept or decline the request on the team page. Nobody joins until you do.

requestDecided.subjectAccepted: You are on the roster of {team}
requestDecided.previewAccepted: Your request to join {team} was accepted.
requestDecided.previewDeclined: Your request to join {team} was declined.
requestDecided.bodyAccepted: The captain of {team} accepted your request. You are on the roster.
requestDecided.bodyDeclined: The captain of {team} declined your request. You are not on the roster.
requestDecided.roster: The roster now has {count} of the {min} runners it needs.
requestDecided.rosterComplete: The roster now has {count} runners — the team is complete.
requestDecided.outroAccepted: The team page shows the roster and how far the team is from being complete.
requestDecided.outroDeclined: You can ask another team, or ask this one again later.

removed.subject: You are no longer on {team}
removed.preview: Your seat on {team} has been removed.
removed.title: You have been removed
removed.intro: The captain of {team} has removed you from the roster. You are no longer part of that team.
removed.outro: If this looks wrong, talk to the captain — they can invite you back at any time.

handedOver.subject: You are now the captain of {team}
handedOver.preview: You have been made captain of {team}.
handedOver.title: The team is yours
handedOver.intro: You have been made captain of {team}. The previous captain stays on as an ordinary member.
handedOver.duty1: Invite runners by email and share the team code.
handedOver.duty2: Accept or decline the requests to join that come in.
handedOver.duty3: Edit the team, remove members, or make somebody else captain.

dissolved.subject: {team} has been dissolved
dissolved.title: The team has been dissolved
dissolved.intro: {team} has been dissolved by its captain. The roster, its invitations and its join requests are gone, and the team page no longer opens.
dissolved.outro: You are free to join another team in this category, or to start one yourself.

confirmRequest.subject: Confirm your participation — {event}
confirmRequest.preview: One link, one button — confirm your place at {event}.
confirmRequest.title: Confirm your participation
confirmRequest.introEntry: {team} has entered {event}, and you are on the entry.
confirmRequest.introAdded: You have been added to {team}'s entry for {event}.
confirmRequest.introReminder: A reminder: {team} has entered {event} and we still need your confirmation.
confirmRequest.body: Open the link below. Your name, date of birth and phone number are already filled in — read the team rules and regulations, tick each acceptance, answer the image question and press one button.
confirmRequest.outro: Until you confirm, we cannot check you in on the night.
confirmRequest.note: This link is personal to you. Please do not forward it.

entryWithdrawn.subject: Withdrawn from {event}
entryWithdrawn.title: Your team has been withdrawn
entryWithdrawn.intro: {team}'s entry for {event} has been withdrawn. You are no longer registered for that night — please do not travel to the venue.
entryWithdrawn.outro: Your captain can enter the team again while registration is open.

entry.heading: Enter an event
entry.hint: Your team enters as a unit. Every member then gets one email with one link to confirm their own participation.
entry.noOpenEvents: No team event is taking entries right now.
entry.incompleteDetail: Your team is not complete yet — {count} more needed.
entry.underageDetail: {name} will be under 18 on the event date.

entryPage.lockedNotice: This team has checked in. The race composition is final.
entryPage.memberNotice: Only your team's captain can change this entry.
entryPage.lockedControls: The team has checked in — the entry can no longer be changed.
entryPage.remindHint: A reminder can be sent to each member once a day.
entryPage.removeMessage: {name} will lose their registration for this event.
entryPage.addHint: Roster members who are not on this entry.
entryPage.withdrawMessage: The entry and every member's registration will be deleted, and all members will be emailed.

register.title: You're almost in

confirm.title: Confirm your spot
confirm.subtitle: Check the details before we lock in your slot for this race night.
confirm.note: No payment needed — the individual mile is free.

guest.title: Register for {event}
guest.detailsSub: We'll email a link to confirm your address and finish your registration.
guest.passwordNote: First confirm your email; your ticket (with a set-password link) arrives right after.
guest.consentNote: After confirming your email you'll be shown the event documents — the rules, the participant statement and the GDPR clause — and asked for your consents there.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to confirm your address — your registration completes and your ticket arrives right after.
checkEmail.resent: Link sent again — check your inbox (and spam).

register.terms: I accept the <link>terms and privacy policy</link>.
register.cancelled: Payment cancelled. You can try again.
register.processingBody: We're preparing your ticket. It'll appear in your profile shortly.
register.teamAlternative: Running with a team this night?
register.alreadyTeamBody: You're on this night's list as a member of {team}. Your confirmation and ticket come through the team, so there is nothing to register here.
register.alreadyBody: You're on the list for this event.
register.verifyBody: Confirm your email address before registering.
register.profileBody: Add your details before registering for events.
register.ageBody: You must be at least 18 years old on race day to register.

consent.title: Documents and consents
consent.subtitle: Read each document and confirm the statements below. They are recorded with your registration — the version you read, in the language you read it in.
consent.answerRequired: Choose one of the two answers.
consent.requiredNotice: We cannot admit you to the start line without the required consents.
consent.incompleteHint: Answer every item and give an emergency contact to confirm.

items.rulesAndRegulations: I have read the event rules ("Public Regulations") and I agree to follow the course and the instructions of the Organizer, judges and safety services.
items.ageHealthRisks: I declare that on the day of the event I am 18 years of age or older, I take part voluntarily, and my health allows me to safely take part — and I knowingly accept the typical risks of a street race (falls, collisions, dehydration, injuries and others).
items.dataTruthfulAndRodo: I confirm that the details I have provided are true, and I have read the GDPR Information Clause for event participants.
items.publicResultsAwareness: I understand that my name, surname, finishing time, ranking position and sport category may be published publicly, while my contact details, address, date of birth and health information are NOT published.
items.prizeDataUnderstanding: I understand that if I finish in a prize position, payout of the prize requires providing bank transfer details and, where necessary, tax data (§ 7A of the Rules).

image.question: Image, photos and recordings — separate voluntary consent
image.agree: I AGREE to the use and dissemination of my individually recognizable image captured during the event in the Organizer's informational, reporting and promotional materials (website, social media), without separate remuneration. I may withdraw this consent for the future at any time.
image.agreeNote: Voluntary consent — you can withdraw it at any time.
image.disagree: I DO NOT CONSENT to the use of my individually recognizable image on the basis of voluntary consent.
image.disagreeNote: Declining does not affect your right to take part in the event.

emergencyContact.label: Emergency contact (name and phone)
emergencyContact.hint: Required — who we call if something happens to you on race night.

address.label: Home address
address.hint: Optional — never published with the results.

lifecycle.upcomingBody: Registration for this race on {date} isn't open yet — check back soon.
lifecycle.closedBody: Registration for this race has closed.
lifecycle.completedBody: This race has already taken place — see how it went.

teamConfirm.title: Confirm your participation
teamConfirm.subtitle: Your captain has entered your team. Read the documents, tick each statement and confirm — that is all we need from you.
teamConfirm.note: Your ticket is emailed to you the moment you confirm.
teamConfirm.validationError: Please answer every required item before confirming.

already.title: Already confirmed
already.body: You have confirmed your participation in this race — your ticket is ready.

age.title: You must be 18 on race day
age.body: We cannot accept your declaration, because you will be under 18 on the day of this event. Ask your team captain to take you off the entry.

cancelled.title: This race has been called off
cancelled.body: The organiser has cancelled this event, so there is nothing left to confirm. Your team's entry no longer holds a place.

gate.title: This link cannot be opened
gate.body: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in with the email address your team captain used, and confirm from your profile instead.

unsubscribe.successBody: You won't receive any more marketing emails from Teams Mile. You'll still get essential emails about events you register for, like tickets and reminders.
unsubscribe.errorBody: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired, so nothing was changed. Use the link from a recent email, or contact us if you need help.

news.empty: No news yet. Check back soon for updates from the mile series.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.subtitle: ACER is Ace Battle account credit: you earn it by turning up and racing, and it is used inside the platform only. 1 ACER = 1 USD.

card.note: Ace Battle account credit, used inside the platform. 1 ACER = 1 USD.
card.empty: You earn 1 ACER every time you are checked in at a race night.

assetNote.ACER: Earned when you are checked in at a race night, and when someone you invited races for the first time.
assetNote.ACE_PL: Not issued yet — shown so you can see the full set of assets.
assetNote.ACEG: Not issued yet — shown so you can see the full set of assets.

purchase.title: Top up
purchase.heading: Buy ACER
purchase.subtitle: Pay by card in US dollars — 1 ACER = 1 USD, whole ACER only. The credit lands in your wallet as soon as Stripe confirms the payment.
purchase.terms: Payment is handled by Stripe, which asks you to accept the <link>terms</link> before you pay.
purchase.note: ACER is Ace Battle account credit. It is used inside the platform only and is not transferable.
purchase.redeem: It is meant for paid entries, season licences and comparable paid features, and as a series prize. Entry to the current events is free, so there may be nothing to spend it on yet.
purchase.refund: Purchased ACER you have not spent can be refunded on request within 14 days of the purchase. ACER received as a reward has no monetary value.

errors.amount: Enter a whole number of ACER between {min} and {max}.
errors.unavailable: Card payments are not available right now. Please try again in a moment.

flash.success: Payment received — your ACER is in the wallet.
flash.settling: Payment received. The credit can take a moment to appear; reload this page if it is not in the history yet. If it is still missing, write to info@poland.acebattle.run.
flash.cancelled: Payment cancelled. Nothing was charged and nothing was credited.

stripe.description: {amount} ACER of Ace Battle account credit. 1 ACER = 1 USD. Usable inside the platform only — not transferable, and it cannot be paid out.
stripe.consent: I accept the Terms of Use and the wallet terms. I ask for the credit to be made available immediately and I acknowledge that, once it has been delivered, I lose the 14-day right of withdrawal.

history.title: History
history.heading: Transaction history
history.emptyHint: Your first ACER lands here the moment you are checked in at a race night.

gate.verifyBody: Your wallet opens as soon as your email address is verified.
gate.profileBody: We need your runner details before the wallet can track what you earn at races.

legal.previewNotice: Preview. The personal fields, the date of signing and the signature are blank because nothing has been accepted yet — they are filled in at the moment you accept this document during registration.
legal.fallbackNotice: A translation into this language isn't available yet — the Polish version is shown below.

attestation.heading: Electronic attestation
attestation.explanation: This is an electronic attestation recorded by the registration system at the moment of acceptance. It replaces a handwritten signature and is evidenced by the record identified above.

docs.przepisy: Public Regulations for the National Individual Ranking Mile
docs.rodo: GDPR Information Clause for Event Participants

teamItems.rulesAndRegulations: I have read the Rules for conducting the team ranking race and the Public Regulations of ACE BATTLE RUN — TEAM MILE POLAND, and I agree to follow the course, the procedure for my race role and the instructions of the Organizer, judges and safety services.
teamItems.ageHealthRisks: I declare that on the day of the event I am 18 years of age or older, I take part voluntarily as a member of my team, and my health allows me to safely run my stage — and I knowingly accept the typical risks of a team ranking race (falls, collisions in the handover zone, dehydration, injuries and others).
teamItems.dataTruthfulAndRodo: I confirm that the details I have provided are true, and I have read the GDPR Information Clause for participants of the TEAM MILE event.
teamItems.publicResultsAwareness: I understand that my name, surname, team, race role, times and ranking position may be published publicly, while my contact details, address, date of birth and health information are NOT published.
teamItems.prizeDataUnderstanding: I understand that if my team finishes in a prize position, payout of the prize requires providing bank transfer details and, where necessary, tax data.
teamItems.imageUse: I AGREE to the use and dissemination of my individually recognizable image captured during the event in the Organizer's informational, reporting and promotional materials (website, social media), without separate remuneration. I may withdraw this consent for the future at any time.
